# Version range cases (sdk.d1_ee_sdk, a fit's provider.version): one per line,
# "accept " or "refuse " and the value, to the end of the line. This file is
# identical in d1-ee-sdk (crates/d1fw-ee-manifest/tests/fixtures/rules/) and
# d1-provisioning (tests/fixtures/ee-manifest-rules/): the SDK's validator
# and the on-robot reader are held to the same verdicts.
accept >=0.2.0, <0.3.0
accept >=0.1.2, <0.2.0
accept =0.1.2
accept 0.1.2
accept >0.1.0,<=0.2.0
accept >= 0.1.0 , < 0.2.0
accept  >=0.1.0
accept >=10.20.30, <11.0.0, >10.20.30
refuse ^0.1.0
refuse ~0.1.0
refuse ~>0.1
refuse *
refuse 0.1
refuse 0.1.x
refuse >=0.1
refuse >=0.1.0-rc.1
refuse >=0.1.0+build.1
refuse >=01.2.3
refuse >=0.1.0,
refuse ,>=0.1.0
refuse >=0.1.0,,<0.2.0
refuse >=0.1.0 || <0.3.0
refuse >=0.1.0 <0.2.0
refuse => 0.1.0
refuse > = 0.1.0
refuse ==0.1.0
refuse v0.1.0
refuse latest
